body:
I found this out today, and found a PR that claimed the docs now match the behaviour (#99754) - it really doesn't.

The docs currently (4.4) say that when enabled, the CanvasLayer stays in a fixed position on the screen - this is not the case. In my project, when follow viewport is enabled, the CanvasLayer is not in a fixed position on the screen. Instead, if the camera moves, the CanvasLayer also moves - it can go off-screen etc. This isn't what I expect for something that is in a "fixed" position on the screen

It sounds to me like the behavior you saw matches #103111:
> If enabled, the CanvasLayer maintains its position in world space.

(or, in your case, follows its position in world space when you move it via the camera position). It is still a bit confusing to understand in the context of camera movement - perhaps we could add something about camera behavior to the PR.

Yes, this kind of error made me doubt my doubts about viewport, screen, chatgpt and even deepseek. I tried to convince myself that the document was correct and I misunderstood the terminology during the game. Such a low-level error should not have happened.
